answer_sentences.text: Yes. The retail lending policy’s scope includes loans to individuals for business purposes, which covers credit granted to natural persons for business use.
answer_sentences.quote: The Policy applies to all retail term loans and demand loans sanctioned by the branches of the Bank, including housing loans, vehicle loans, personal loans, education loans, loans against deposits and gold loans, and to loans to individuals for business purposes.

answer_sentences.text: The policy also separately states that loans to individuals for business purposes, including loans to proprietors of MSEs, are subject to the Loan Policy.
answer_sentences.quote: Loans to individuals for business purposes, including loans to proprietors of MSEs, shall be appraised on the basis of the cash flows of the business and shall be subject to the exposure limits in the Loan Policy.
